shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
The weather today is quite nice and sunny.
My favorite sport to play with friends is soccer.
Cooking new recipes can be very exciting and fun.
Traveling to new places always broadens my perspective.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
Exercising regularly is important for maintaining good health.
Volunteering in my community gives me a sense of purpose.
Taking online courses can greatly enhance your skills and knowledge.
Participating in group discussions improves your ability to communicate effectively.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning languages.
questions: Q1: What languages have you learned or are currently learning?
Q2: What challenges have you faced while learning a new language?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the best way to learn a language?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone starting to learn a new language?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly behaviors.
questions: Q1: What eco-friendly habits do you practice in your daily life?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in maintaining those habits?
Q3: How important do you think it is to be environmentally conscious?
Q4: What suggestions would you give to others wanting to adopt eco-friendly practices?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What kinds of exercise do you enjoy doing most?
Q2: What barriers do you face when trying to stay active?
Q3: Why do you think physical fitness is important for everyone?
Q4: What tips can you provide for someone looking to develop a regular exercise routine?
